_comment: PLACEHOLDER LINE-UP. Replace or extend these entries when the real models are decided. allowed_options may be "*" (every option of that component) or a list of option ids.

shoes.name: SoleMate Court
shoes.tagline: Performance basketball shoe built on your scan.
shoes.description: The spiritual successor to the original Sole-Mate project: a court shoe with a custom last, lockdown tuned to your instep height and a toe box cut to your toe width.

shoes.name: SoleMate Stride
shoes.tagline: Everyday runner with a scan-matched toe box.
shoes.description: Neutral daily trainer. Pick the foam, choose the upper, and the last is graded to your foot length and ball girth.

shoes.name: SoleMate Daily
shoes.tagline: Casual low-top in cloth, leather or suede.
shoes.description: A clean everyday sneaker. Canvas, leather or suede uppers on a rubber, PU or gum sole with an optional cork footbed.
